security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are Markdown formatting false positives, including endpoint names, prompt examples, and API path placeholders. I confirmed intended RunComfy CLI commands and outbound Model API requests. They execute local tools and send user data to RunComfy. No prompt injection text or covert malicious intent was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: The skill relies on local RunComfy CLI execution.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before installation or RunComfy commands, and keep prompt data passed as structured JSON arguments.

remediation.issue: Prompts, reference image URLs, and request metadata are sent to RunComfy.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the external data transfer disclosure visible, and warn users not to submit secrets or private image URLs.

remediation.issue: RunComfy credentials may be stored on disk by the CLI.
remediation.suggestion: Document token revocation, logout behavior, and the RUNCOMFY_TOKEN option for ephemeral environments.

content.user_title: Generate GPT Image 2 Assets on RunComfy
content.value_statement: Teams need image prompts and edits that preserve text, layout, and brand details. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to use RunComfy's GPT Image 2 endpoints with clear size, edit, and privacy rules.
actual_capabilities: Guides text-to-image generation through the RunComfy GPT Image 2 endpoint.
Guides image edits with up to 10 publicly fetchable HTTPS reference images.
Documents the three fixed output sizes and edit auto-size behavior.
Provides prompt patterns for embedded text, logos, multilingual typography, and layout control.
Explains CLI behavior, exit codes, token storage, and outbound endpoints.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and a RunComfy account or token.
Text-to-image supports only three fixed sizes.
Edit references must be publicly fetchable HTTPS URLs.
It is not a direct OpenAI API client.

use_cases.title: Create Product Campaign Images
use_cases.description: Generate product hero images with accurate labels, simple backgrounds, and brand-safe lighting.

use_cases.title: Localize Visual Brand Assets
use_cases.description: Adapt signs, packaging, and posters with short multilingual text while keeping layout consistent.

use_cases.title: Draft Labeled Mockups
use_cases.description: Create UI mockups, diagrams, and scientific illustrations where readable labels matter.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Product Hero
prompt_templates.prompt: Use GPT Image 2 on RunComfy to generate a portrait product image for [product]. Include exact label text "[text]". Use size 1024_1536.

prompt_templates.title: Edit While Preserving Identity
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this reference image with GPT Image 2. Change [background or detail]. Keep the subject, face identity, pose, and framing unchanged.

prompt_templates.title: Localize Brand Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Use GPT Image 2 to create [number] variants of this asset with headline "[translated text]". Keep layout, colors, and product placement consistent.

prompt_templates.title: Compose a Multi-Reference Ad
prompt_templates.prompt: Use image 1 as the product, image 2 as the room, and image 3 as lighting reference. Create a [format] ad with exact headline "[headline]".

output_examples.input: A product hero request for a ceramic bottle with the label AQUA+.
output_examples.output: A portrait product image saved to the selected output folder, with the bottle centered and the label text visible.

output_examples.input: A reference product photo and a request to replace the background with a clean studio setting.
output_examples.output: An edited image that keeps the product shape and label while replacing the background and lighting.

output_examples.input: A poster localization request with a short Japanese headline.
output_examples.output: A localized poster concept with the requested headline rendered on the sign area.

best_practices: Quote exact embedded text and keep it short.
Use auto size for edits unless the framing must change.
Change one attribute per iteration to preserve composition.
anti_patterns: Do not combine conflicting instructions, such as no text and a required headline.
Do not place long paragraphs inside generated images.
Do not include secrets or private image URLs in prompts.

faq.question: Do I need an OpenAI API key?
faq.answer: No. The skill uses RunComfy, so you need a RunComfy account or token.

faq.question: Which image sizes are supported?
faq.answer: Text-to-image supports 1024_1024, 1024_1536, and 1536_1024. Edit also supports auto size.

faq.question: Can it edit more than one reference image?
faq.answer: Yes. The edit endpoint supports up to 10 publicly fetchable HTTPS reference images.

faq.question: Where is the RunComfy token stored?
faq.answer: The RunComfy CLI stores login tokens under the user config directory. CI can use RUNCOMFY_TOKEN instead.

faq.question: Does this skill send data to an external service?
faq.answer: Yes. Prompts and reference image URLs are sent to the RunComfy Model API.

faq.question: Is it best for photorealistic portraits?
faq.answer: No. The skill says GPT Image 2 is stronger for text, layout, signage, and brand assets.
